text:
My neighbor recently decided to up the security stakes by putting up a sign that read, "Beware of Dog." Naturally, this was meant to intimidate, but it completely backfired when the postman arrived. Out trotted my three-pound furball, a creature so small he could fit in a teacup. The postman didn’t even flinch; he just looked down and said, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

Now, my dog is on a personal mission to prove him wrong. He’s been practicing his "fierce" bark, which sounds more like a squeaky toy being stepped on, and he’s been trying to look intimidating by standing on his hind legs, which mostly just makes him look like a fuzzy, confused poodle. I think the postman is going to need a lot more than a sign to be truly afraid of him!

The color of an eggplant is purple.
